title: Why content sells better than ads
description: Why content sells better than ads
transcript: Our new strategy is to drive content everywhere to our YouTube channel. if I can get somebody to consume a few hours of content from me, they will very likely buy and they'll buy and they'll buy again. We noticed the trend that everybody was coming from YouTube, but here I was still running a lot of top of funnel cold ads at the same time, and I wasn't really focusing on YouTube. It was pretty funny because when we looked at stuff, top of funnel cold ads is where people ask for refunds, charge backs. You know, if it was like a longer sales cycle, people coming from YouTube, it was like literally a slam dunk. And the people coming from YouTube also already really knew how to be my clients. They knew who I was. And so, like, they came on board and we had to do, just for illustration purposes, let's say 20% of the work to get them a 10 x result that we did. Somebody coming over from cold ads because we had to teach them on our strategies for scaling.
